optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware

professionalSummary.text: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.
professionalSummary.witness: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.

professionalSummary.text: Watched the charging session success rate on the fleet dashboard after each release wave and held the field on-call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet-wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on-call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.
professionalSummary.witness: Watched the charging session success rate on the fleet dashboard after each release wave and held the field on-call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet-wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on-call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated the rollout waves for each release with the operations centre, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the operations centre's wave sign-off.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the rollout waves for each release with the operations centre, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the operations centre's wave sign-off.

professionalSummary.text: Tested each firmware version on the hardware-in-the-loop rig before release, with the rig test record attached to the release ticket.
professionalSummary.witness: Tested each firmware version on the hardware-in-the-loop rig before release, with the rig test record attached to the release ticket.

professionalSummary.text: Wrote the release notes for each version, listing the known limitations on the older station models and the hand-over conditions for the field technicians.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the release notes for each version, listing the known limitations on the older station models and the hand-over conditions for the field technicians.
